# drape

> drape (https://drape.nyc) is a free digital closet app with AI virtual
> try-on. Users photograph the clothes they own; drape auto-crops and
> auto-tags each piece into a browsable closet, composites any item or outfit
> onto the user's own body photo (face, body, and pose preserved), logs daily
> outfits on an OOTD calendar, and includes a community feed and a
> peer-to-peer closet marketplace with direct messages. iOS, Android, and
> web. English, Korean, Japanese.

Key facts
- Pricing: free; 5 virtual try-ons per day, invite bonuses.
- Try-on preserves the user's real face and body — not a generic model.
- Closets and identity photos are private by default; sharing is opt-in.
- Marketplace: list closet items for sale; buyers can try pieces on
  themselves before buying and message the seller.

Links
- Web app: https://drape.nyc/
- iPhone: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6775511709
- Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.uihyun.drape
